title: Standardize .beads/ gitignore — allowlist form (92 .br_history snapshots committed)
description:
⚠️ 92 .beads/.br_history/ snapshot files are committed (significant history noise bloating the repo). Fix: `git rm -r --cached .beads/.br_history` and `git rm --cached .beads/metadata.json`, then adopt the allowlist .gitignore.

Standard (matches protoPen PR #73 + upstream pattern in steveyegge/beads#919): replace .beads/.gitignore with the allowlist form:

    *
    !issues.jsonl
    !config.yaml
    !routes.jsonl
    !.gitignore

Committed = shared source of truth (issues.jsonl, config.yaml, routes.jsonl). Ignored = local/runtime (beads.db*, *.lock, .br_history/, daemon.*, metadata.json, .local_version, last-touched, *.tmp). Robust: new volatile files br adds are ignored automatically, no .gitignore churn. Verify with git check-ignore after.

title: Telemetry setup incomplete: Langfuse env vars and telemetry settings object undocumented
description:
docs/contributing/telemetry.md exists but is missing:
1. Langfuse env var setup: LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY, LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY, LANGFUSE_BASE_URL. These auto-activate telemetry when set (see packages/core/src/telemetry/sdk.ts buildLangfuseExporters).
2. The 'telemetry' settings object in settings.json (schema: TelemetrySettings).
3. OTLP configuration: telemetry.otlpEndpoint, telemetry.otlpProtocol ('grpc'|'http'), telemetry.outfile, telemetry.enabled.
4. The opt-in gate: telemetry.enabled = true is now required even when Langfuse env vars are set (previously env vars alone activated exports). This is a behavior change documented in sdk.ts lines 106-116.

title: hooks-design.md missing if field and SdkCallback hook type
description:
docs/explanation/hooks-design.md (How Hooks Work) is missing:
1. The 'if' field for fine-grained argument filtering (syntax: ToolName(glob), examples like 'Bash(git *)'). This is documented in use-hooks.md but the explanation page omits it.
2. The SdkCallback hook type (HookType.SdkCallback). Defined in packages/core/src/hooks/types.ts. Used for SDK programmatic hook registration. No docs exist for it.
3. PostToolUseFailure and Notification event categories.
